d:
Christopher Smart, founder of Arbroath Group and former special assistant to the president at the National Economic Council during the Obama Administration, said that Trump's push to reinstate Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia shows that the company is at the heart of the future of US national security and AI innovation, as well as holding up a major piece of the US economy. Smart said there are high stakes for the AI trade and that if the AI build out starts to unravel the US would be 'talking about a recession pretty quickly.'
